enqueue_base_ms: PROXY: NR_SUBMIT_PROBE measures per-closure CPU ENQUEUE time and sums it by family; enqueue cost is ~linear in the number of SYCL submissions, so it ranks WHERE the remaining launches are -- it is NOT a launch count (a true count needs a submission counter, which the engine does not have).
the submit-probe path runs the PLAIN closure loop (no cgraph) and returns early, so its GPU timings are not the shipping replay path; only the enqueue column is meaningful here.
